lead: `cargo fmt` after a run of Edit-tool changes floods the session with full-file diffs.
body: The harness reports every file a command touched that you had previously read, and a tree-wide `cargo fmt` touches all of them at once — one call cost about 12k of context here, more than the edits it was tidying. Format the crates you actually changed (`cargo fmt -p nvs-types -p nvs-ir`) or let `verify.py`'s fmt leg report instead, and reach for the tree-wide one only when the wrap is already written.
